item.name: Count tokens for a message request

header.description: Anthropic API version header sent by the official `anthropic` SDK. Accepted (any value) but currently has no effect on response shape - included for drop-in SDK compatibility.

request.description: Anthropic `count_tokens` compatible endpoint. Returns the number of input tokens that would be consumed by a `POST /messages` call with the same prompt content (system, messages, tools, tool_choice). Authentication accepts either the bearer `Authorization: Bearer ` header (SambaNova SDK default) or the `x-api-key` header (Anthropic SDK default); the same API key is used in both cases.

response.name: Successful response. Returns the input token count.

Anthropic API version header sent by the official `anthropic` SDK. Accepted (any value) but currently has no effect on response shape — included for drop-in SDK compatibility.

request.description: Anthropic Messages API compatible endpoint. Generates a model response for the supplied conversation. Authentication accepts either the bearer `Authorization: Bearer ` header (SambaNova SDK default) or the `x-api-key` header (Anthropic SDK default); the same API key is used in both cases. When `stream: true` is set, the response is a sequence of Server-Sent Events whose payloads conform to `MessageStreamEvent`; otherwise the response is a single `Message` object.

response.name: Successful response. Returns a `Message` object (non-streaming), or a stream of Server-Sent Events whose payloads conform to `MessageStreamEvent` ending with a `message_stop` event (when `stream: true`).
